The single apparent numeric mismatch — the PCA9685 being strapped to I2C 0x41 (A0 tied to +3.3 V) whereas the spec table lists 0x40 — is the electrically required resolution of an address clash with the INA219 (0x40) that shares the same SCL/SDA net pair (NET0088/NET0170); the schematic's own 'I2C address: 0x41' note confirms 0x41 as the intended strap, so this is a spec-table typo rather than a board anomaly. No confirmed deviation from intended behaviour was found.
